Maharashtra TET Exam Postponed Amid Suspected Question Paper Leak

The Maharashtra Teacher Eligibility Test (TET) has been postponed due to a suspected question paper leak, impacting over six lakh candidates. Three suspects have been arrested, and authorities are searching for a Bihar-based individual believed to be the mastermind behind the leak, with alleged links to similar incidents in four other states over 25 years. The incident has sparked protests and calls for the resignation of the state's Education Minister.
